properties.name: solace.commons.connection.client-name
properties.description: Optional client name sent to the broker. If not specified the broker assigns one automatically.

properties.name: solace.commons.connection.host
properties.description: Broker host URI (e.g. {@code tcp://localhost:55555} or {@code tcps://broker.example.com:55443}).

properties.name: solace.commons.enabled
properties.description: Master switch – set to {@code false} to disable all consumers without removing config.

properties.name: solace.commons.reconnect-retries
properties.description: Number of reconnect retries before giving up.

properties.name: solace.commons.reconnect-retry-wait-ms
properties.description: Milliseconds to wait between reconnect attempts.

properties.name: solace.commons.snapshot-timeout-ms
properties.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait when consuming a snapshot ( {@link ConsumerMode#SNAPSHOT}) before timing out.

properties.name: solace.commons.subscriptions
properties.description: Topic subscriptions to create on startup.

properties.name: solace.commons.trigger-timeout-ms
properties.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for a correlated response in {@link ConsumerMode#TRIGGER_THEN_CONSUME} mode.
